title: Learning from Interaction Experience via Localized Context Distillation
abstract: arXiv:2610.21427v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Learning from interaction experience is essential for enabling large language models to continually improve during deployment. Context distillation offers a promising path: privileged information extracted from experience is provided to a teacher, whose behavior is then distilled into a student model that has no access to it. However, both existing forms of context distillation have limitations. Off-policy context distillation trains the student on teacher-generated trajectories and thus suffers from exposure bias; whereas on-policy context distillation trains on the student's own rollouts, whose states are often uninformative and fail to convey behaviors the student cannot yet produce. To resolve this dilemma, we introduce Localized Context Distillation (LoCD). LoCD first localizes the critical spans of a student trajectory that require revision. translated_title: 基于局部化上下文蒸馏的交互经验学习
translated_abstract: 从交互经验中学习对于使大语言模型在部署过程中持续改进至关重要。上下文蒸馏为此提供了一条有前景的路径：将从经验中提取的特权信息提供给教师模型，再将其行为蒸馏到无法访问该信息的学生模型中。然而，现有的两种上下文蒸馏形式都存在局限：离线策略上下文蒸馏在教师生成的轨迹上训练学生模型，因而存在暴露偏差；而在线策略上下文蒸馏虽然基于学生模型自身的采样轨迹进行训练，但这些轨迹的状态往往信息量不足，无法传达学生模型尚不能产生的行为。为解决这一两难困境，我们提出了局部化上下文蒸馏。LoCD首先定位学生轨迹中需要修订的关键片段，然后由教师模型基于学生自身的前缀仅对这些片段进行重新生成，学生……
tldr: 提出局部化上下文蒸馏方法，通过定位学生轨迹中需要修订的关键片段，并让教师模型仅基于学生自身前缀重新生成这些片段，从而兼顾离线与在线策略上下文蒸馏的优势，解决暴露偏差与状态信息不足的问题。
en_tdlr: Proposes Localized Context Distillation (LoCD), which localizes the critical spans of student trajectories requiring revision and lets the teacher regenerate only those spans from the student's own prefix, combining the advantages of off-policy and on-policy context distillation to overcome exposure bias and uninformative states.
